metadata.short_desc: Generic fallback plugin: combine multiple provider fallback chains into a virtual model for AstrBot and other plugins
metadata.desc: Generic fallback plugin. Configure virtual models composed of multiple provider fallback chains for AstrBot itself and other plugins. Provides OpenAI-compatible proxy endpoints, a cooldown ladder, manual disable, call logs, and a monitoring panel with custom rules.

proxy_host.hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 (local only); use 0.0.0.0 for external access

proxy_api_key.hint: Optional. When set, clients must send this key in the Authorization header

empty_response_max_attempts.hint: If a provider returns an empty response, retry it this many times before moving to the next provider. Empty-response detection currently supports non-streaming only

cooldown_policy.hint: Each entry is [consecutive failures, cooldown minutes] in ascending failure order. The default means 1 failure = 1 min, 2-4 = 5 min, 5+ = 30 min. Below the first threshold uses the first tier. A JSON string is also accepted

call_log_max_per_provider.hint: Logs are kept per provider independently (latest N each). Set to 0 to disable log retention

virtual_models.hint: Each virtual model corresponds to one provider fallback chain

default.name: Fallback virtual model
default.hint: Configure a model name exposed to clients and its provider fallback list

display_name.hint: Used by clients when requesting; the legacy name field is still supported

provider_ids.hint: In priority order; select at least one provider

page_background.hint: Set a background image for the proxy monitoring page; leave empty to show none. Single image only. Keep the file small (a few MB) to avoid slow page loads

page_background_opacity.hint: Background opacity (0 fully transparent, 1 fully opaque); only applies when a background image is set

page_background_blur.hint: Background blur radius (pixels); only applies when a background image is set

monitor.title: Fallback Monitor
monitor.description: View cooldown status, consecutive failure counts, and virtual model configuration for each provider.
monitor.rulesHint: A failure reason containing the match text (case-insensitive) counts as one hit; reaching the threshold on consecutive hits triggers the chosen action. One success resets the counter. Click Save to apply changes. "Cooldown until midnight" supports its own timezone (blank = local), since foreign providers often reset quotas in other timezones.
monitor.ruleTzTitle: Only for the "Cooldown until midnight" action: blank or local = local timezone, UTC = universal time, offset hours such as -8/+9/+5.5
monitor.ruleTzHint: Timezone format: blank/local = local timezone, UTC/GMT = universal time, offset hours such as -8, +9, +5.5, UTC+08:30
monitor.rulesEmpty: No rules yet. Add one below.
monitor.tzInvalidFormat: Invalid timezone format (use local / UTC / GMT / UTC±N, or offset hours such as -8, +9, +5.5, range -24~24)
monitor.tzOutOfRange: Timezone offset out of range (should be between -24 and 24)
monitor.errThreshold: Count must be an integer greater than 0
monitor.errCooldownMinutes: Cooldown minutes must be a number greater than 0
monitor.noProvider: This virtual model has no providers
monitor.streamEmptyResponse: Empty streamed response ×{n} in a row
